text:
Maria P: Quick sync — running an instructor shadow day next Wed for new SI cohort. I uploaded a short instructor deck + checklist. Need volunteers to shadow + a volunteer to own the tiny cert ops run (grading, proctoring notes).
Aj K: I can shadow, and I can own cert ops if it stays light. What's the expected grader load? :thinking_face:
Maria P: Thanks Aj. Expect ~12 trainees, one optional practical task per trainee, and a short multiple-choice exam (20 q). Estimate 2-3 hrs of grading if we automate MCQs and one 2-hr practical review block.
Sam L: Drop the deck link? Also can we record the session and get the slides for DevEx training gallery.
DeployBot: New file uploaded by Maria P: https://redwood.internal/docs/si/instructor-shadow-day-deck-v1.pdf
Tara R: I can take one shadow slot (10:30–12p). Happy to help with the practical review if needed. :handshake:
Aj K: For proctoring — proposal: automated MCQ scoring + peer-review for practicals (2 reviewers per practical). Use this rubric: clarity, correctness, infra reproducibility.
Maria P: That sounds good. Sam, can you add the recording and short intro snippet to the training gallery after the session? We'll also surface the rubric in the cert packet.
Sam L: Yep. I'll create a short entry in the gallery. Also can we include a quick sandbox access play for SIs? Marketplaces credits would help.
Aj K: We have a small pool of cloud credits for certified SIs. Suggest: give 48-hr sandbox credits for the cohort to run through labs. Ops: assign a voucher code per trainee.
Maria P: Approved. Aj — please work with partnerships billing to reserve 12 vouchers. Also please publish the trainer checklist; I pasted the working checklist in the deck but here's the raw snippet for easy copy:
Maria P: ```
- Pre-day: confirm trainer + recording tech, share pre-reads
- Day: introductions, 2x demos, 30m hands-on lab, Q/A
- Post-day: upload recording, auto-score MCQ, assign practical reviewers, send cert invite
```
Tara R: Can we have a 30-min dry run Monday? I'd like to rehearse the hands-on demo sequence.
Maria P: Yes — dry run Monday 4pm. I'll send calendar invites. Last ask: volunteers for one practical reviewer slot (2-3 people needed). Who's in?
Aj K: I'll take one reviewer. Will coordinate reviewers' checklist with Sam.
Sam L: I'll take one reviewer slot too.
Maria P: Great — that covers it. I'll update the deck with proctoring flow and publish the cert ops doc after the dry run. Thanks everyone! :tada:
